exposure: classical cesarean section described by M. Stark
cohort: The study included 205 patients who delivered via cesarean section at the Obstetrics department of the Kherson regional clinical hospital.
finding: The modified cesarean section technique significantly reduced both surgery duration and the volume of intraoperative blood loss by 200 ml compared to the classical cesarean section described by M. Stark.
mod_finding: The modified cesarean section technique resulted in significantly less intraoperative blood loss and shorter surgery duration compared to the classical cesarean section technique.
